public.text: Deploying a Client Registry and shared APIs is presented as an example of reducing duplication immediately. Identity reconciliation can initially expose or amplify duplicate and conflicting records rather than immediately reduce them.
public.suggestedRevision: Add data-profiling, matching-quality assessment, manual adjudication, source remediation, merge governance, and monitoring as prerequisites for identity integration.
